create_conversation_template: create a conversation template with a name, system message, roles, and separator style for a model
register_conv_template: register a new conversation template in the global chat_templates registry by name
get_conv_template_by_model_path: get a registered conversation template name that matches a given model path string
generate_chat_conv: generate a conversation object from an OpenAI ChatCompletionRequest with system, user, and assistant messages
generate_embedding_convs: generate a list of conversation objects from parallel text, image, and video lists for embedding tasks
